concerns.text: The plan defines a safety signal solely by the condition ‘≥ 2 of the three disproportionality metrics (ROR, PRR, IC) meet preset thresholds’ (see “Flag a signal if **≥ 2** of the three metrics meet thresholds (FR‑005)”). This constitutes a circular/tautological validation: the outcome (signal flag) is derived directly from the same metrics that are used as predictors, with no independent ground‑truth or external validation dataset. Consequently the analysis can only ever confirm its own internal definition and cannot assess false‑positive rates or real‑world relevance.
